title: Add Confluence guide authoring and sync tools
description: Companion to ai-intake-mcp's curated-guide-retrieval.md: new tools/prompt in documentation-mcp (ensure_guide_index, list_guides, sync_guide, write_guide) that draft a guide, publish it to Confluence as a leaf page, and add/update its row on the shared index page ai-intake-mcp reads from during ticket planning.
